# Setup — `cheap-crew-brief` in `cloud-session`

*To run this pattern in this environment, do the steps below. Generated by `labs/process-refinery`; regenerate rather than hand-edit.*

## Inputs

API keys (DEEPINFRA_KEY at minimum), the pinned roster, a task with a verifiable gate

## Steps

1. Use the pinned roster (CONVO-QUILT-IDEATION.md §II.1) — don't re-probe: DeepInfra DeepSeek-V4-Flash / GLM-5.3-Flash / Qwen3.8-Flash / Ling-3.0-flash / MiMo-V2.6-Pro / gpt-oss-120b; z.ai via the CODING endpoint.
2. Keep a stable prompt prefix so repeat calls hit the provider cache.
3. Crew proposes in volume (temperature 0 for labelling, higher for ideation); the 5.5 model only decomposes and verifies.
4. Gate every crew output with a verified cell (B7, probes, TypeSafe typed-check, or a deterministic rule) before it counts.
5. Cache the crew output in the repo so the report/selftest is reproducible offline.

## Receipt

a cached crew-output file + a gate that accepted/rejected it deterministically + a token-split line
